plan.title: Explore data structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) image count and sizes in data/train/images/, (2) annotations.json structure — number of annotations, categories, images, (3) distribution of annotations per image, (4) distribution of annotations per category, (5) category names and IDs, (6) check for 'corrected' field, (7) examine data/products/ structure and data/metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Clear understanding of data dimensions, category distribution, image sizes, reference product availability logged to stdout

plan.title: Setup environment and create train/val split
plan.hypothesis: We can create a proper 90/10 stratified split and verify all dependencies work
plan.description: Install/verify ultralytics, torch, torchvision, pycocotools. Create 90/10 train/val split (seed=42) by image, keeping all annotations for each image together. Output train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format. Target ~223 train / ~25 val images.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, dependency versions printed, CUDA confirmed available

plan.title: Write evaluation function and convert to YOLO format
plan.hypothesis: We can implement the val_score metric and prepare YOLO training data
plan.description: Implement evaluation function computing: detection_mAP@0.5 (single class), classification_mAP@0.5 (357 classes), val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Also convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with proper directory structure and dataset YAML. Test eval function with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function works correctly, YOLO format data created with correct label counts

plan.title: YOLOv8m baseline at 640px with nc=357
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m provides a reasonable baseline, achieving val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Skip nano/small to save time - medium is a good starting point. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function.

plan.title: Diagnose torch/torchvision compatibility and find working setup
plan.hypothesis: The NMS operator error is caused by mismatched torch/torchvision versions; we need to find what's pre-installed and work with it
plan.description: In scratch.py: (1) Print exact versions of torch, torchvision, and CUDA toolkit. (2) Check if torchvision.ops.nms works directly. (3) Try importing ultralytics and see if it works. (4) If NMS fails, try: uninstalling both torch+torchvision then reinstalling matching versions, or using --force-reinstall. (5) Test with a minimal YOLO inference to confirm the operator works. (6) Also check if there's a CPU-only torchvision conflicting with CUDA torch.
plan.success_criteria: Identify the exact version mismatch and find a pip install command sequence that makes torchvision.ops.nms work

plan.title: Force-reinstall torchvision and verify YOLO works
plan.hypothesis: Using pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps for torchvision matching the pre-installed torch 2.6.0+cu124 will fix the NMS operator error
plan.description: In main.py, before any training: (1) Run 'pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps torchvision==0.21.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124' to force reinstall torchvision matching torch 2.6.0+cu124. (2) Verify torchvision.ops.nms works. (3) Install ultralytics. (4) Run a minimal 2-epoch YOLOv8n training on the dataset as smoke test. If --force-reinstall doesn't work, try: deleting torchvision site-packages directory manually then reinstalling, or using 'pip install torchvision==0.21.0+cu124 --no-deps --target=<custom_path>' and adding to sys.path.
plan.success_criteria: torchvision.ops.nms executes without error AND YOLOv8n completes at least 1 training epoch, producing val_score > 0

plan.title: YOLOv8n quick baseline (5 epochs, 640px)
plan.hypothesis: With working environment, 5 epochs of YOLOv8n with nc=356 produces val_score > 0
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n with nc=356, imgsz=640, epochs=5, batch=16 as end-to-end pipeline validation. Evaluate on val split using the existing evaluation code.
plan.success_criteria: val_score > 0.0, confirming the full pipeline works

plan.title: YOLOv8m baseline at 640px with 50 epochs
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=356, imgsz=640, epochs=50, batch=16, patience=20. Use cosine LR scheduler, mosaic augmentation, and proper warmup.

plan.title: Explore reference product images and DINOv2 embedding quality
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings of reference product images can classify cropped detections with >50% top-1 accuracy
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory coverage vs 356 categories. Load DINOv2-base, extract embeddings for all reference product images. Test kNN classification accuracy on val split crops using ground truth boxes.
plan.success_criteria: Understand reference image coverage and DINOv2 classification potential

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO detector + DINOv2 classifier
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 kNN classification achieves higher val_score than nc=356 YOLO alone
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m/x with nc=1 (all products as single class) for better detection recall. Then classify each detection crop using DINOv2 kNN against reference gallery. Evaluate full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds the nc=356 YOLO baseline from step 8

plan.title: Tune detection and classification hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS, confidence thresholds, and kNN parameters improves val_score by 2+ points
plan.description: Sweep: NMS IoU [0.4-0.8], confidence [0.05-0.3], kNN k=[1,3,5,7], distance metric [cosine, L2]. Also test augmenting gallery with training crops.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.02 over previous best

plan.title: Build and test complete submission pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Complete pipeline runs within 300s and achieves best val_score
plan.description: Write run.py combining best detection + best classification. Verify correct output format, timing budget, and file size constraints. Use only allowed imports.
plan.success_criteria: Valid submission that runs end-to-end within constraints

plan.title: Final optimization and submission packaging
plan.hypothesis: Final tuning produces a valid, optimized submission
plan.description: Run final configuration sweep combining all best settings. Optimize inference speed. Verify submission constraints: ≤3 weight files, ≤420MB, allowed extensions.
plan.success_criteria: Best possible val_score within submission constraints
